requirement: v3.4.7: the backup engine ships content-addressed dedupe, atomic writes, repository locks, the 22:00 Asia/Shanghai schedule with missed-slot catch-up, per-session old/ rotation, gc with reference safety, the Windows DPAPI machine envelope with password fallback, and the dsh-backup subplugin row introduced together with the engine.

assertions.dedupe: second backup of unchanged sessions writes no new blocks; dedupe_ratio reported
assertions.schedule: defaults to 22:00 Asia/Shanghai; a missed slot is caught up once; the effect can stop the scheduler
assertions.rotation: newest-N per session, old records readable, pointers updated atomically
assertions.gc: unreferenced blocks collected; referenced blocks never deleted; BACKUP_GC_UNSAFE refuses on unreadable references
assertions.locks: a held lock refuses a second writer with BACKUP_LOCKED
assertions.envelope: machine secret protected through a real PowerShell DPAPI round trip; password path via scrypt
assertions.wiring: the dsh-backup row, lib/backup.js export and routes land in the same commit as the engine (37653b6)
